import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("measurements.csv")

print("Per-specimen linear fits (free intercept)")
per_spec = []
for (mat, spec), g in df.groupby(["material", "specimen"]):
    x, y = g.strain.values, g.stress_mpa.values
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
    pred = slope * x + intercept
    r2 = 1 - ((y - pred) ** 2).sum() / ((y - y.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    per_spec.append((mat, spec, slope, intercept, r2))
    print(f"{spec:6s} E={slope:9.1f} MPa  b={intercept:7.2f} MPa  R2={r2:.6f}")

print("\nPer-material fits (pooled specimens, free intercept)")
mats = ["aluminum", "steel", "titanium"]
results = {}
for mat in mats:
    g = df[df.material == mat]
    x, y = g.strain.values, g.stress_mpa.values
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
    pred = slope * x + intercept
    r2 = 1 - ((y - pred) ** 2).sum() / ((y - y.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    slopes = [s for (m, _, s, _, _) in per_spec if m == mat]
    results[mat] = dict(slope=slope, intercept=intercept, r2=r2,
                        n=len(g), spec_mean=np.mean(slopes), spec_std=np.std(slopes, ddof=1))
    print(f"{mat:9s} E={slope:9.1f} MPa (={slope/1000:7.2f} GPa)  b={intercept:7.2f} MPa  "
          f"R2={r2:.6f}  n={len(g)}  per-spec mean={np.mean(slopes)/1000:.2f} +/- {np.std(slopes, ddof=1)/1000:.2f} GPa")

colors = {"aluminum": "#1f77b4", "steel": "#d62728", "titanium": "#2ca02c"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
xfit = np.linspace(df.strain.min(), df.strain.max(), 100)
for mat in mats:
    g = df[df.material == mat]
    ax.scatter(g.strain, g.stress_mpa, s=28, color=colors[mat], alpha=0.6,
               edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.3, label=f"{mat} data")
    r = results[mat]
    ax.plot(xfit, r["slope"] * xfit + r["intercept"], color=colors[mat], lw=2,
            label=f"{mat} fit: E={r['slope']/1000:.1f} GPa (R²={r['r2']:.4f})")

ax.set_xlabel("Strain (dimensionless)")
ax.set_ylabel("Stress (MPa)")
ax.set_title("Tensile stress–strain data with linear elastic fits")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper left")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("stress_strain_fits.png", dpi=200)
print("\nSaved stress_strain_fits.png")

with open("results.md", "w") as f:
    f.write("# Elastic modulus of aluminum, steel, and titanium\n\n")
    f.write("Estimated from a linear (least-squares) fit of stress vs. strain over the "
            "elastic region (strain 0.0002–0.0020), pooling the three specimens of each "
            "material. Units: modulus in GPa (1 GPa = 1000 MPa).\n\n")
    f.write("![Stress–strain data with linear fits](stress_strain_fits.png)\n\n")
    f.write("## Results\n\n")
    f.write("| Material | E (GPa) | Fit intercept (MPa) | R² | Specimens |\n")
    f.write("|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
    for mat in mats:
        r = results[mat]
        f.write(f"| {mat.capitalize()} | {r['slope']/1000:.1f} | {r['intercept']:.1f} | "
                f"{r['r2']:.5f} | 3 |\n")
    f.write("\n## Per-specimen moduli\n\n")
    f.write("| Specimen | E (GPa) | R² |\n|---|---|---|\n")
    for mat, spec, slope, _, r2 in per_spec:
        f.write(f"| {spec} | {slope/1000:.1f} | {r2:.5f} |\n")
    f.write("\n## Notes\n\n")
    f.write("- The modulus is the slope of the stress–strain relation, so it is taken as "
            "the slope of the linear fit rather than from a single point.\n")
    f.write("- All fits are close to linear (high R²), consistent with an elastic response "
            "over the measured range.\n")
    f.write("- Steel is stiffest (~200 GPa), titanium intermediate (~115 GPa), and aluminum "
            "least stiff (~68 GPa), matching typical handbook values.\n")
print("Saved results.md")
